title: Movement Ecology of Animals Conference
level: Researchers (as stated on the conference page)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Movement Ecology of Animals" takes place from 30 May to 4 June 2027 at Renaissance Tuscany Il Ciocco in Lucca (Barga), Italy. Applications are submitted through the conference page on grc.org.
card_alt: Card for "Movement Ecology of Animals Conference" by Gordon Research Conferences, held in Barga, Italy, deadline 2 May 2027. The photo shows the Colosseum, Rome (a representative image of Italy, not the event venue).
